![Why do brides wear veils? | CNN](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11090303-2247-0139-0000-0035758a5ac2:4)
Brides wear veils `as a tradition that blends ancient superstitions, religious customs, and modern fashion`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-HBXXCPMM1DcwRBBL2x3XdEfO-2Jg4ED2cE2eTmHpHsu8jpQVpAoOwQpGWHDirmhFiZ-Gbq1pXJzh_RfuGhEqklwnt_sceIblfIFj5sXlSRtMHLoy8-0JerLP_QvbUraNaJD2uj74UMuuJfpwob0stQTeIiQI8EnUgs)

### Historical Origins

- **Warding off evil spirits:** In ancient Greece and Rome, brides wore veils—such as the Roman *flammeum* , a bright flame-colored veil—to disguise themselves and scare away jealous spirits or demons that might ruin their happiness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESxQEBxCJF1xDBVdf5yLhlY1PGTjHoUAnR_1jWQJ3CpmZi2P4L3hc28wJEHuDNbUwwwLtdF-VcFG1WU0HXKfDWplebXUBz2zk3Aru0DxwHSEGx4al8jMFLqGcJeVvs4tgfw5WXaRg1jdkomXl2QZYvWXs8oxYcvIswxGeSLHlpJCwgxg67XwdqbiDaNiw00dkxrMOOBBfMEYnWN4EMP8-Puar9u-75tOzYbThfcD65Ha5p8zK5_VdtCVNfsctbet7G3npCZq_OMA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-HBXXCPMM1DcwRBBL2x3XdEfO-2Jg4ED2cE2eTmHpHsu8jpQVpAoOwQpGWHDirmhFiZ-Gbq1pXJzh_RfuGhEqklwnt_sceIblfIFj5sXlSRtMHLoy8-0JerLP_QvbUraNaJD2uj74UMuuJfpwob0stQTeIiQI8EnUgs)
- **Concealing identity in arranged marriages:** In eras when marriages were arranged by families, the veil covered the bride's face until the ceremony ended, preventing the groom from backing out if he disliked her appearance.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF122m1_w-q91PVKSA09R60GtZNAZLmb6HTLrGPQKVrPMqZvHiT4Ebhme4rKU4TxxqeaUmGSTvo9icD94of0EF0l3ckWu5E_OWVKrC4Hw7G1rFELbyCezzg3t7o-VrVcPudhuDBHs0sfqZLIyuPo51EUL1m9lOI9zD1SBSIFqAC5QUUYDH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-HBXXCPMM1DcwRBBL2x3XdEfO-2Jg4ED2cE2eTmHpHsu8jpQVpAoOwQpGWHDirmhFiZ-Gbq1pXJzh_RfuGhEqklwnt_sceIblfIFj5sXlSRtMHLoy8-0JerLP_QvbUraNaJD2uj74UMuuJfpwob0stQTeIiQI8EnUgs)
- **Sign of status:** During the medieval and Victorian eras, elaborate lace and heavy veils showed off the wealth and social standing of the family . Queen Victoria popularized the long white lace veil in 1840.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-jPkEZj9wGOcCVon-1RHNh4q4jLvPiX66ytFvcuwKCWX8dsi3un0RXC48QZpv9DKomR9AD25f75ucIrbZqH3z4kyrNjGhtr2LQwAsjhsvxdJrnubaVMKGd2tm5sD71stdeYPZvQD0o-hefRWX6jZL7n23ZjSImRWm6xfrSUgvii4A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-HBXXCPMM1DcwRBBL2x3XdEfO-2Jg4ED2cE2eTmHpHsu8jpQVpAoOwQpGWHDirmhFiZ-Gbq1pXJzh_RfuGhEqklwnt_sceIblfIFj5sXlSRtMHLoy8-0JerLP_QvbUraNaJD2uj74UMuuJfpwob0stQTeIiQI8EnUgs)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF16ba4CFhJ2IzBmGn0H82Jj8Uw2-5_K3Fl97KJFxLAw9g19Q88UNKY8T030OF5Hz5-ljtJqDd7mtJDQSvdV19HdzsOOn7qvwkl5fkuswYrRY22B-u8QiFswVd2VB-U0J03xWz-hrgFmI7ET8uzMjDbJoy7jFYdZTa7YNJic3TVvyni2gxM1clLw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXj9x8iaRja1e6ljBVnt5lfD3BXIfB3w8yFsdVviHsRrC24ymy7dYF25YmfsdB_h-mUof8iA_kktlFZYB2Hve5b00SD8glWKqlg4LZr4YAtNQsDVI0MhEwbWq8C7VHBuwYdqdRCoDNLZEEIs8lchFMtA3H_iT-AWSj7w)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpgEBxCJF10N2Xf59Bi1qBMb14B9aUvNo9ehHFtNFqhwRlBy4M10ZZgJaw8yoHe_NhC5UeaMTZbvmglaehUuxclx4q4kR_sw_l9MP0jQEwHpW8VXbcuJZUeVN4mEsAYz9kZddnATWmo4SIynmrS5oAa4A2TWUSFGZ3FviMnPSmEukCmqbfNc3xA44Cu_MPZrwOtHY8axHHLmm0Pn_J3jRNja19fO8JJhq)

### Religious & Symbolic Meanings

- **Purity and modesty:** In Western Christian traditions, the white veil came to symbolize the bride's chastity, modesty, and reverence before God.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXwHEIkXXdL7xc0LVcZo0ENueJbNF1Csi6cxHprj_JphAwciHTxSz3Iyl7c2o5MboytRhjC8JHflIQO6QKy-99sZLgABb98eVM4Q8FLqTgY9WYYGAQ68rDQeJp_32carm)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-HBXXCPMM1DcwRBBL2x3XdEfO-2Jg4ED2cE2eTmHpHsu8jpQVpAoOwQpGWHDirmhFiZ-Gbq1pXJzh_RfuGhEqklwnt_sceIblfIFj5sXlSRtMHLoy8-0JerLP_QvbUraNaJD2uj74UMuuJfpwob0stQTeIiQI8EnUgs)
- **Spiritual inner beauty:** In Jewish customs, the *bedeken* ceremony involves the groom lifting the veil to confirm he is marrying the right person and to honor inner spiritual beauty over physical appearance.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXj9x8iaRja1e6ljBVnt5lfD3BXIfB3w8yFsdVviHsRrC24ymy7dYF25YmfsdB_h-mUof8iA_kktlFZYB2Hve5b00SD8glWKqlg4LZr4YAtNQsDVI0MhEwbWq8C7VHBuwYdqdRCoDNLZEEIs8lchFMtA3H_iT-AWSj7w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESxQEBxCJF1xDBVdf5yLhlY1PGTjHoUAnR_1jWQJ3CpmZi2P4L3hc28wJEHuDNbUwwwLtdF-VcFG1WU0HXKfDWplebXUBz2zk3Aru0DxwHSEGx4al8jMFLqGcJeVvs4tgfw5WXaRg1jdkomXl2QZYvWXs8oxYcvIswxGeSLHlpJCwgxg67XwdqbiDaNiw00dkxrMOOBBfMEYnWN4EMP8-Puar9u-75tOzYbThfcD65Ha5p8zK5_VdtCVNfsctbet7G3npCZq_OMA)
- **Global customs:** Other cultures use head coverings and veils with distinct meanings—such as red veils for luck in traditional Chinese weddings (*xiu he tou* ), or the *dupatta* and *ghunghat* in South Asian ceremonies.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-HBXXCPMM1DcwRBBL2x3XdEfO-2Jg4ED2cE2eTmHpHsu8jpQVpAoOwQpGWHDirmhFiZ-Gbq1pXJzh_RfuGhEqklwnt_sceIblfIFj5sXlSRtMHLoy8-0JerLP_QvbUraNaJD2uj74UMuuJfpwob0stQTeIiQI8EnUgs)

### Modern Usage

- **Fashion and aesthetics:** Today, many brides wear a veil simply because they love the timeless, romantic look, how it frames the dress, or the soft effect it creates in wedding photos.
- **Personalization:** Modern brides often customize veils with unique embroidery, family heirlooms, or sheer modern fabrics.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF16ba4CFhJ2IzBmGn0H82Jj8Uw2-5_K3Fl97KJFxLAw9g19Q88UNKY8T030OF5Hz5-ljtJqDd7mtJDQSvdV19HdzsOOn7qvwkl5fkuswYrRY22B-u8QiFswVd2VB-U0J03xWz-hrgFmI7ET8uzMjDbJoy7jFYdZTa7YNJic3TVvyni2gxM1clLw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF122m1_w-q91PVKSA09R60GtZNAZLmb6HTLrGPQKVrPMqZvHiT4Ebhme4rKU4TxxqeaUmGSTvo9icD94of0EF0l3ckWu5E_OWVKrC4Hw7G1rFELbyCezzg3t7o-VrVcPudhuDBHs0sfqZLIyuPo51EUL1m9lOI9zD1SBSIFqAC5QUUYDH)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-HBXXCPMM1DcwRBBL2x3XdEfO-2Jg4ED2cE2eTmHpHsu8jpQVpAoOwQpGWHDirmhFiZ-Gbq1pXJzh_RfuGhEqklwnt_sceIblfIFj5sXlSRtMHLoy8-0JerLP_QvbUraNaJD2uj74UMuuJfpwob0stQTeIiQI8EnUgs)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-jPkEZj9wGOcCVon-1RHNh4q4jLvPiX66ytFvcuwKCWX8dsi3un0RXC48QZpv9DKomR9AD25f75ucIrbZqH3z4kyrNjGhtr2LQwAsjhsvxdJrnubaVMKGd2tm5sD71stdeYPZvQD0o-hefRWX6jZL7n23ZjSImRWm6xfrSUgvii4A)

Read more about bridal traditions and styles on [The Wedding Veil Shop](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-HBXXCPMM1DcwRBBL2x3XdEfO-2Jg4ED2cE2eTmHpHsu8jpQVpAoOwQpGWHDirmhFiZ-Gbq1pXJzh_RfuGhEqklwnt_sceIblfIFj5sXlSRtMHLoy8-0JerLP_QvbUraNaJD2uj74UMuuJfpwob0stQTeIiQI8EnUgs) or explore runway history via [CNN Style](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-jPkEZj9wGOcCVon-1RHNh4q4jLvPiX66ytFvcuwKCWX8dsi3un0RXC48QZpv9DKomR9AD25f75ucIrbZqH3z4kyrNjGhtr2LQwAsjhsvxdJrnubaVMKGd2tm5sD71stdeYPZvQD0o-hefRWX6jZL7n23ZjSImRWm6xfrSUgvii4A).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-HBXXCPMM1DcwRBBL2x3XdEfO-2Jg4ED2cE2eTmHpHsu8jpQVpAoOwQpGWHDirmhFiZ-Gbq1pXJzh_RfuGhEqklwnt_sceIblfIFj5sXlSRtMHLoy8-0JerLP_QvbUraNaJD2uj74UMuuJfpwob0stQTeIiQI8EnUgs)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-jPkEZj9wGOcCVon-1RHNh4q4jLvPiX66ytFvcuwKCWX8dsi3un0RXC48QZpv9DKomR9AD25f75ucIrbZqH3z4kyrNjGhtr2LQwAsjhsvxdJrnubaVMKGd2tm5sD71stdeYPZvQD0o-hefRWX6jZL7n23ZjSImRWm6xfrSUgvii4A)Are you planning a wedding and trying to **decide on a veil length** (like cathedral, fingertip, or blusher), or are you looking for **cultural history** on a specific type of veil?
